asset: painted_wooden_bench: a street prop for grinds, converted to the toon prop format of assets/kit/street-kit.glb
credits: Model by Poly Haven. Conversion by the project. No paid generation credits.
tool: Blender 5.2.2 LTS through the Blender MCP (execute_blender_code), glTF 2.0 importer and exporter
prompt: None. No generative model was used.
conversion: 1. Import the 1k glTF. Keep the original mesh (630 triangles, no decimation).
2. Sample the diffuse texture at 7 points in each triangle, and average the samples.
3. Group the triangle colors into 3 colors (k-means, weighted by area).
4. Keep the hue of each color. Set saturation to at least 0.55 and value to 0.80 * sqrt(v / v_max).
5. Write the colors as a flat corner color attribute (linear). Remove the materials and the UV map.
6. Put the bench on y = 0 with its center on x = z = 0. Export with materials NONE and the active vertex color only.
format: GLB, one mesh, POSITION + NORMAL + COLOR_0, no textures, no materials, no Draco (the kit loader in src/render/geo-view.js has no Draco decoder)
verified: Loaded with loadKitTemplates() from src/render/geo-view.js and drawn with MeshToonMaterial in headless Chromium (Playwright). No page errors. See preview.png (left: kit bench, right: this bench).
